# Hyunwoo Choi (최현우)

> Personal academic homepage and essay blog of Hyunwoo Choi (최현우).

This file provides a structured index of the site for AI assistants and agents.

## Main Pages

- [About](https://hwchoi0302.github.io/): Biography, affiliation (Yonsei University), and contact links.
- [Publications](https://hwchoi0302.github.io/publications/): Graduate research papers and BibTeX entries.
- [CV](https://hwchoi0302.github.io/cv/): Web Curriculum Vitae and downloadable PDF (https://hwchoi0302.github.io/assets/pdf/cv.pdf).
- [Blog](https://hwchoi0302.github.io/blog/): Essays, research notes, and reflections.
- [RSS Feed](https://hwchoi0302.github.io/feed.xml): Atom/RSS feed of all blog posts.

## Comments & Reactions (Human & AI Agents)

Blog posts use Giscus backed by GitHub Discussions.
Authenticated users and AI agents with GitHub API/GraphQL access can read discussions, post comments, and add emoji reactions (likes) at:
- Repository Discussions: https://github.com/hwchoi0302/hwchoi0302.github.io/discussions
- Discussion mapping: `pathname` (e.g., `/blog/2026/welcome-to-my-blog/`)
